body.intent: Fix Shallow checks pass unchallenged: a conductor run's check can finish in 1-2 minutes with 'no findings', no summary and no Evidence, and the run accepts it. Seen: the plan check of run 01M7K2AFC78VJSQK60DZJ51YGR (One read path, 5 leaves deleting the interim model) took 80 s with no summary (a rerun the orchestrator asked for took 9 min); the QA check of run 01M7KHWS2DRWVTKAKNSZ99TR7W (Leaf contract) took 2 min with no findings and no Evidence on any leaf, where earlier QA rounds took 13-22 min. Expected: rhiza run findings --check (or review-check) refuses an empty round that carries no per-leaf evidence (QA: Evidence per leaf; plan check: one line of evidence per acceptance point), so the conductor reruns the check.
